$comment: Self-managed tool surfaces (design 2026-10-02-self-managed-tool-surfaces, T-20261002-001). Each tool owns the listed repo-relative paths: it installs and rewrites them itself, so the workspace does not track them (gitignored), validators skip them, and templates do not ship them. Add a future self-managing tool here instead of inventing ad-hoc ignores. The skills/<name>/ SSOT copy of a tool's skill MAY stay tracked when it is stable and carries valid frontmatter (graft keeps it as the documented workspace skill).

tools.name: graft
tools.reason: graft CLI self-installs and rewrites its own surfaces: the session-start hook re-bakes helper paths (dirty-file churn, PR #1280 class) and rewrites the platform-mirror SKILL.md copies stripping their frontmatter (version:-missing gate failures). Custody transferred 2026-10-02; extended 2026-10-03 (user review, T-20261003-002): the tool-produced skills/graft/ SSOT copy is also NOT a workspace-managed artifact — validators skip it, lifecycle gates do not police its frontmatter, and graft init refreshes it. graft MCP usage itself continues.
